name: dsh-goat-vision
description: GOAT-quota vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a new provider route that claims image input, transcribes attached images to text via deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (same Command Code / GOAT endpoint), then delegates the text-only conversation to the wrapped pi-ai commandcode adapter (deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro brain).
